default: a weathered porch rail worn smooth by boot heels
coiled rope hung from porch posts
a row of corrals fanning out toward the barn
feed troughs lined along the near fence
a windmill turning slow above the water tank
western: branding irons cooling in a bucket by the gate
a saddle slung over the porch rail
a dented washbasin set out on a bench

situations.text: branding cattle at the corral gate
mending a stretch of broken fence line
sharing a plain supper on the porch steps
an argument over water rights at the fence line
breaking a new horse in the corral, dust rising
sitting quietly on the porch as the light fades
watching a storm roll in over the open range
